ask: draw secret santa names for all 8 of us so nobody gets themselves and we each only see our own
sentence: Draws one random gift-giving cycle for everyone in the chat so nobody gets themselves, and each person can reveal only their own match.
use_when: a group wants to draw secret santa names
each person should privately see who they give a gift to
a gift exchange needs a fair random assignment
someone needs to redo the draw after a mistake
dont_use_when: picking one random winner or person from the group
splitting people into teams or groups
splitting costs or tracking who owes what
making a wish list or gift idea list
